Comment EBOOK and I'll send you the full Faceless AI Affiliate ebook. 🔒

Your first 30 posts aren't content. They're data.

Nothing moves for weeks. Then it starts to build. Most people quit in the quiet part, right before it turns.

The loop:

1. Make ten posts in one sitting.
2. Post every day. Don't change the plan halfway.
3. Check saves and comments. Not likes.
4. Do more of what worked. Drop the rest.

Saves mean they plan to come back. Comments are what the app rewards most. Sends mean one person told another. Likes tell you almost nothing.
